sn35.206:1.1: Yadanicca Cakkhum bhikkhave aniccam paccuppannaṃ || yad aniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ || yaṃ dukkhaṃ tad anattā || yad anattā taṃ Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || Sotaṃ || || Ghānaṃ || || Jivhā || || Kāyo || || Mano anicco paccuppanno || yad aniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ || yaṃ dukkhaṃ tad anattā || yad anattā tam Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti || Evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || Evam passaṃ || pe || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
